environment.description: Jenkins-based CI/CD cluster running on EKS. Pipeline cache service deployed as a sidecar container in the build namespace. Network policy allows ingress from any pod in the 'ci-workers' namespace. Pipeline tokens are HMAC-SHA256 signed with a static shared secret stored in a Kubernetes Secret (rotated manually during quarterly maintenance). Token TTL is set to 86400s (24 hours). No deserialization filtering configured on the JVM. Commons-collections 3.2.1 is on the classpath via a transitive dependency from an older Maven plugin.
